truth.description: The JSON with Comments language now infers the new jsonc parser, but chooseLayout in assignment.js, which printProperty reaches through printAssignment, still keeps a value on its key's line only for json and json5, so a long string value in a .jsonc file, such as the $schema URL of a cspell.jsonc, now moves to its own line after the colon.

distractions.why: The fenced block is tagged jsonc and this run sets trailingComma to all, which the jsonc parser now honors, so the comma after the last property is the expected output.
